title: From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment
abstract: arXiv:2611.28197v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly

translated_title: 从点云到工程模型：建筑环境中的智能体3D重建基准测试
translated_abstract: 编码智能体可以将3D测量数据转化为CAD几何图形，但为建筑环境重建工程模型需要超越表面拟合的语义解释和一致的构造约束。我们将场景级Scan-to-BIM（建筑信息建模）形式化为一个智能体3D编码任务，并引入S2Bench基准，该基准包含五个领域共128个真实场景的公开和专有扫描数据，并配有专家精选的、涵盖多样空间尺度的参考模型。一个共享框架使智能体能够使用Python测量扫描数据，在实时CAD/BIM内核中构建带类别标签的构件，并对其代码进行迭代优化。我们还提出了并行异步协作方法：由主导者分配带版本管理的任务，在工作节点执行的同时继续建模，并整合受修订约束的提案。对五个智能体和一个协作团队共1,028次重建的评估表明，扫描到模型的残差直接（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出首个场景级Scan-to-BIM智能体3D编码基准S2Bench（涵盖五个领域128个真实场景），并引入并行异步协作机制，让多智能体分工建模、持续迭代优化工程模型重建。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces S2Bench, the first benchmark for scene-level agentic Scan-to-BIM 3D coding spanning 128 real-world scenes across five domains, and proposes a parallel asynchronous collaboration mechanism where a lead delegates versioned tasks to workers for continuous modeling and refinement.
